# nss magazine

> > nss magazine is a contemporary fashion and culture publication covering luxury brands, streetwear, creative directors, and the intersection of fashion with art and digital culture.

The site features editorial content spanning fashion history, designer profiles, footwear culture, and interactive experiences. nss explores major fashion houses like Gucci, Prada, Dior, and Alexander McQueen alongside emerging brands and cultural phenomena from platforms like Tumblr and American Apparel.

## Key Topics

- luxury fashion brands
- creative directors
- footwear and sneaker culture
- fashion history
- Gucci
- Prada
- Dior
- Alexander McQueen
- AMBUSH
- 1017 ALYX 9SM
- Acne Studios
- American Apparel
- Tumblr aesthetics
- fashion photography
- designer directory

## Fashion Industry Reference

- [A guide to all creative directors - the history of fashion by nss](https://allcreativedirectors.nssmag.com/): Directory of fashion creative directors at Gucci, Prada, Dior & more

## Fashion Coverage

- [Footwear - nss france](https://www.nssmag.com/fr/footwear): French section covering sneaker culture, hype models, and designer history

## Optional

- [Fashion or Porn? - THE GAME](https://vault.nssmag.com/labs/pof): Interactive quiz game distinguishing fashion photography from adult content
